name: Detroit
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Detroit for 2026, and here is what he found: 28 family events inside the city, with free photos with Santa at Winter Wonders at Entrance One and a free Holly Trolley among the newest. The magic runs from November 27 (Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit) through January 3, 2027 (the Holly Trolley), with Noel Night, the Detroit Symphony and library Santa visits along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Detroit

  • 28 Christmas events for kids in Detroit city limits, after the suburb cards move to their own towns
  • New free events: Winter Wonders at Entrance One (photos with Santa, through December 24) and the Holly Trolley (weekends through January 3)
  • Meet Santa: Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit, Cadillac Lodge brunch and Detroit Public Library branch visits
  • Trolley: the complimentary Holly Trolley links Nick Gilbert Way, Campus Martius, Book Tower and Capitol Park
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to January 3, 2027
